name: Zed
description: Zed is a GPU-accelerated code editor written in Rust by the team behind Atom. Released 1.0 on April 29, 2026, it ships with a built-in agent panel, multi-buffer editing, real-time collaboration, and tight integration with frontier models. Personal mode supports BYOK for any provider; the Pro tier includes Zed-hosted models and prompt routing.
pricingDetails: Personal: free (BYOK). Pro: $20/month (Zed-hosted models, $20 in token credits, 2-week trial). Business plan available.
